meta.title: Partner with PoStory
meta.description: You own the client, we handle content production and execution. Prepay per client, price however you like, and try it free on one real client first.

hero.title: You own the client, we handle content production and execution
hero.subtitle: Prepay per client and set your own resale price. Try it free on one real client first — a 30-day plan plus 3 images — then keep going if you like it.
hero.sampleCaption: Real sample: Sophie Chen Beauty Studio, a beauty studio in Canada

who.title: Who this is for
who.body1: You already have a handful of local-business clients and want to outsource content production so you can focus on client relationships.
who.body2: You run marketing retainers for businesses and want to add content production and publishing execution.
who.body3: You have clients but no steady shooting/design/scheduling capacity, and want to buy that per client.

division.title: How the work splits
division.body1: Owns the client relationship, collects client info and assets, sets the resale price
division.body2: Provides real product/service facts and assets, confirms the direction
division.body3: Produces the agreed content, adapts it per platform, and handles publishing

deliver.title: What you get
deliver.body1: Produced at the agreed volume — the same image adapted for different platforms doesn't count twice
deliver.body2: Counting and revision rules are still being finalized, and don't follow the image rules
deliver.body3: A month of posting cadence laid out by industry and client info
deliver.body4: Exported per-platform versions, published on the agreed schedule
deliver.body5: A summary of that month's output and publishing

how.title: How it works
how.body1: Fill in the client's basic info, product/service, and assets once
how.body2: Use a private link to see the 30-day plan and 3 trial images
how.body3: If you're happy, prepay per client and scope to start the real engagement
how.body4: Keep submitting assets on an agreed cadence while PoStory keeps producing and publishing

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.body: Priced per client and scope — you set your own resale price. The same image adapted for different platforms counts as one piece of content; a new image is what uses up an allowance.
pricing.example: Example: 3 different images, each adapted for Instagram and Facebook — 6 platform versions total, using only 3 images' worth of allowance.

participate.title: How clients take part
participate.body: You forward the client a private link where they fill in the rest and upload assets. The first trial doesn't require connecting social accounts — that happens once the client moves into the real publishing service.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: Always a 30-day marketing plan + 3 images, limited to once per client — you can request it separately for different clients.
faq.q2: Can we trial without complete assets?
faq.a2: Yes — missing assets get a reasonable substitute without slowing things down, and you can add more later.
faq.q3: How long does the trial take?
faq.a3: Timing depends on our production schedule; the private link page keeps the status updated.
faq.a4: During the trial you can give feedback on style and content accuracy; revision rules for the real engagement are agreed when you confirm.
faq.q5: Do we need to connect the client's social accounts?
faq.a5: Not for the trial — that happens once the client moves into the real publishing service.
faq.q6: Do we resubmit info when going paid?
faq.a6: No — the trial info and confirmed style carry straight over, nothing to redo.

closing.title: Submit a client and start your free trial
closing.body: Try it on one real client first — keep going if you like it.

trial.title: Free trial: 3 sample images
trial.subtitle: Fill in once, get a private link to track progress
trial.scopeNote: The trial scope is fixed at a 30-day marketing plan + 3 images; adding more platform variants never reduces that 3-image allowance.
